checkpoint_review: The Router's checkpoint verdicts are generally accurate and well-reasoned. All 8 checkpoints were marked as testable and present, which aligns with the visual evidence. The head is indeed broader than the pronotum with prominent compound eyes. The mandibles are visible and sickle-shaped. The antennae are filiform and extend forward, though their exact length relative to the midbody is somewhat ambiguous due to the angle, but the Router's assessment is reasonable. The body is elongated and slender with metallic green coloration and pale markings on the elytra. Six legs are visible and appear cursorial. The exoskeleton is chitinous and segmented. I agree with all verdicts; the Router was not overly lenient.

The geometric_depth_auditor's depth map shows a reasonable depth range, but the depth statistics alone don't confirm structural integrity. I agree with the Router's severity ratings; they are appropriately low for minor issues. No new significant artifacts were found by experts that the Router missed.
